item.title: The Science Behind Forest Healing: Can Nature Really Calm The Mind?
item.description: Forest healing works by immersing the senses in natural environments that calm the mind and body. Through Shinrin-Yoku, the sights, sounds, scents, and textures of the forest trigger relaxation responses, lower stress, and restore emotional balance. This multisensory experience helps the brain shift from tension to deep, natural tranquility.
